finalText:
By default, React re-renders a child every time its parent re-renders, no matter what props you pass. Same props doesn't stop it on its own.

Two things fix this:
1. Wrap the child in `React.memo` — it skips re-rendering when props haven't changed.
2. If you're passing inline functions or objects as props (like `onClick={() => ...}`), those are new every render, so even `React.memo` won't catch it. Wrap them in `useCallback` or `useMemo` to keep them stable.
